name: The Creature
source:
Adrian decides to take a break from everything and camp out in the woods for a weekend. Something approaches their tent on a late night.

[From [url=https://rodfireproductions.itch.io/the-creature]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Adrian決定暫時放下一切，在樹林裡露營一個週末。深夜，有什麼東西靠近了Adrian的帳篷。

[來源：[url=https://rodfireproductions.itch.io/the-creature]Itch.io[/url]]
